description: FC-LAB-006: after a valid push-up, cycles whose required joints are outside the image cannot add reps. Tests the active-state boundary, not the already-covered off-screen start.
oracle: A complete, four-second push-up counts once. Translating every required joint two image widths off-screen makes the next three cycles unobservable, even with high reported confidence. The count must remain one. Positive control prevents muting the entire counter from passing.

steps.label: The requested push-up movement is active
Positive control: a complete push-up counts once
Off-screen cycles cannot add push-ups after arming
Framing loss does not falsely finish the set
User can still leave the interrupted set
